content:
nina: Kickoff: CloudMarket co-hosted panel + hands-on demo with FluxGrid on Sep 14. Need speaker roster, demo fallback plan, and a contactless claimpass swag flow. Can people take owners?
oliver: I can run speaker confirmations and collect bios/headshots. Can we lock names by next Tue?
jess: Marketing here. I'll build the landing page and need 1-sentence blurbs + headshots by Mon. Also want a separate micro-CTA for demo signups.
tom: I'll own demo ops. Primary will run on FluxGrid private endpoint; fallback is a local container + a pre-rendered short clip. Also prepping an offline JS wrapper so demo can run in browser with no network if needed.
ops-bot: calendar: "CloudMarket x FluxGrid Panel + Demo" created Sep 14 16:00-17:00 PT. Dry run Sep 12 10:00 PT. Links added.
nina: Swag idea: use a "claimpass" flow. After registering, attendees get a single-use code (claimpass) via email/SMS. At venue, they scan a QR at a contactless smart-pod to redeem. Pods are small lockers with remote unlock. Advantages: no booth queues, trackable redemptions.
jess: Love it. Also limit to one claimpass per registration to avoid hoarding. Promo card inside package should include a short QR to signup for trial.
oliver: FluxGrid can provide one on-site engineer for 30m handoff. Contact is Ravi (ravi@fluxgrid.io). They can help with private endpoint routing.
tom: Tech checklist for fallback: prebuilt container, local static HTML fallback, 90s MP4 walkthrough on S3, and a zipped dataset for offline demo. I'll bring a mini NUC with the container preloaded.
nina: Pod ops: vendor confirmed smart-pod model "Keyless-Box v2". Pod sits near Hall C entrance. Need pod ID and power plug. Also need volunteer staffing windows.\ops-bot: task: Pod vendor shipment ETA Sep 12 08:00 local. Delivery note added to event.
jess: Volunteer shifts: 15:30-16:30 lead @tom, 16:30-17:30 backup @nina. FluxGrid volunteer covers 17:30-18:00. Will that work?
oliver: Yes. Also we should pre-generate claimpasses and QR codes tied to registration IDs. I can export a CSV of reg IDs for the vendor.
tom: Pod manifest draft: 
- 120 claimpass envelopes (sealed)
- 40 demo USB dongles (pre-configured)
- 20 mini dev kits (boxed)
- 140 one-page quickstarts
I'll add weights/dims and courier label tonight.
nina: For live demo fallback sequencing: 1) try FluxGrid endpoint (primary) 2) switch to local container (60s transition) 3) if issues, play 90s clip and open to Q&A. Moderator script will include the exact phrases to call fallback.
\oss-bot: reminder: Dry run Sep 12 10:00 PT. Notifying all panelists 24h prior.
jess: Legal note: do not mention specific cost or latency numbers in slides without sign-off. Use qualitative phrasing.
oliver: I'll push speaker approvals to PR by Fri. Also need headshots and pronouns for slide slide template.
tom: AV list: 1x HDMI input, 1x spare HDMI-to-USB capture, wired ethernet or private 5G hotspot, power strip. I'll bring adapters + spare battery pack.
nina: Final checklist: speakers & bios by Tue, claimpass CSV & pod manifest by Sep 10, slides by Sep 5, dry run Sep 12. I'll DM owners and post a final updated manifest in the drive. Thanks all :sparkles:
